scope: Finite development matrix, not formal population/model efficacy. 18 conditions x 3 fresh layouts x 3 methods = 162. Stable staged states, source acquisition scripted via known AX name in unique Workspace. Final-check arm alone pays another full observation. Capture after final check adds an explicitly logged non-atomic gap.
H: Document/scope/backend-node binding and final read should refuse named changed-identity states and repair moved original targets without claiming business-semantic identity or atomic input.

D.scoped_pass: All non-boundary bound_final cases have zero wrong/background/no_event; stable,move_before,other_scope,move_between remain target in all seeds; no input on refusals, trusted coordinate-consistent app effects and verified button release for every click; replay/retention passes.
D.default_promotion: HOLD unless zero wrong inputs across ALL cases. Boundary negatives count against default promotion, not excluded from reporting.
D.uncertain: missing records, source drift, absent trust/release evidence

T: One ordered allocation split by three predeclared layout blocks; each block once, no optional stopping except harness error; persist every row plus block archive before next block. Smoke layout 123 is excluded.
C: same observable node may change application meaning
state may mutate after last observation
strict hit test may reject child elements
native channel is richer than pixels
U: scripted target names, staged rather than continuous mutation, same-process scorer separation only, single Linux/Xvfb/Chromium platform, uncontrolled scheduler/CPU clock; no provider tokens/latency or numeric coverage factor inferred
